name: ATV Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: an all-terrain quad bike with chunky tyres and a grinning face on its front fender
entry: Its huge tyres grip any rock. It loves sneaking up behind hikers on mountain trails and revving its engine until they jump.
how: Use a ATV Engine on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Power Gem in this form.
